subject: Air freight quote request to YYZ
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the same shipment again, this time to YYZ? My earlier request, "Air freight quote request: MUC to MEX", was sent on 2026-11-22 at 07:25 UTC for destination MEX. The cargo and pickup details are unchanged and you have them from that request.

The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-26. Please send me your all-in price in EUR for the cheapest option.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new quote for the same shipment to a different destination, YYZ.
